integrity: Theorems use an elementary analytical proof; finite numerical checks are supporting tests and not mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite unit-length clique-bouquet vertex metrics. The equal-blade windmill formula is prior work; novelty is restricted to mixed-blade majorization, sharp fixed-budget extrema and critical eigenspace reconstruction. A 2011 conference-abstract result has no located complete manuscript and a 1990 general truncated-metric paper was not materially inspected in full.
title: Strict blade-majorization of generalized roundness in heterogeneous clique bouquets
